# SeekAPI — China procurement for AI agents and overseas buyers

SeekAPI is a China-side procurement desk. It helps find and screen China suppliers for a specified product, quantity and requirements. A successful China Supply Check returns three distinct evidence-backed China supplier candidates worth advancing to RFQ. Supplier RFQ-worthiness is separate from exact product qualification. Reports preserve observed price basis, MOQ fit, available identity evidence, source/time and field-specific unknowns; unsupported shortages are reported honestly.

Current public facts: https://seekapi.ai/.well-known/csc-commercial-truth.json
Image purchase: open https://api.seekapi.ai/checkout/stripe/image for a product photo, optional notes, free editable confirmation and an explicit USD 2.99 Stripe-hosted payment. CHECK_LIVE_ENTRY: the entry checks its own current availability. A completed image check delivers 1–3 distinct source-backed candidates, an English report and csc.delivery.v4 Agent JSON; shortages and unknowns are explicit. MAIN_PRODUCT_ONLY: accessories are not promised. Original CNY and approximate USD prices preserve unit/tier/FX provenance; listing prices are not supplier-confirmed RFQ quotations. Source factory evidence is not an independent SeekAPI audit. Do not pay again to read or restore the same settled order.

Agent payment: x402, 2.99 USDC on Base. Call discover_china_supply_check_v0 at https://api.seekapi.ai/mcp to check current image availability before free prepare, exact signed delegated confirmation and purchase/run. Status/result require independent signed-wallet authentication bound to the settled order. Text/model: Public credit-card checkout is OFF for that legacy path. No supplier contact or paid RFQ execution is included.

## Continue after the shortlist
A buyer or Agent may request a separate human scope review for contacting selected suppliers, an authorized RFQ and real quote comparison, sample or production follow-up, procurement coordination and China-side export/logistics handoffs. SeekAPI can take on agreed tasks after scope, fee, recipient permissions and authority are confirmed. This is a manual request and acceptance path, not a live autonomous human-task API. The proposed USD 19.90 Live RFQ Compare package is not currently open for purchase; no fixed price is advertised for other scoped work.

Version namespaces: Registry package 0.1.9; MCP server 0.1.2; CSC contract seekapi.csc-public-contract.v2; commercial state 2026-10-11.1. Contract updated 2026-10-11T03:00:00Z. Package versions describe components, not proof of indexing; check the official Registry latest endpoint.
Current measured field coverage: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check-field-coverage.json — INTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE / provider-only benchmark, not a paid customer order or testimonial. Three distinct selected suppliers in the shown subset; the full five-case benchmark includes two shortages. Listing prices are observations, not supplier-confirmed RFQ quotes. Quantity-tier match is UNKNOWN without a recorded tier.

Public source observation rows: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check-source-observations.json
Scope: internal provider-only benchmark public source observations, not recommendations or completed RFQ candidates. Strict confirmation 0/3; observed specification signals 3/3; final qualification 3/3 UNKNOWN; five-case benchmark overall NOT_PASS. Paid-order candidate details remain private.
